capabilities: generate daily multiple-choice quizzes from chosen vault folders
answer questions and see explanations and a final score
track a participation streak with streak freezes
display a dashboard with accuracy, scores, and a 12-week completion heatmap
optionally auto-generate at a set time and log results to a Markdown note
extras: Manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README notes sampled note text leaves the vault at generation time and the API key is stored unencrypted in data.json.
problem: Obsidian stores and links notes but offers no built-in way to actively recall them, so reviewing what you wrote requires leaving the vault or external quizzing tools.

relations.evidence: install BRAT, then Add beta plugin → FilhoRicardo/vaultquiz

requires.name: MiniMax, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider

summary: Study plugin that generates a daily multiple-choice quiz from your own notes using a bring-your-own LLM key and tracks a participation streak.
